dialogues.speaker: Yongzan
dialogues.text: Me? I'm just an ordinary guard for hire.

dialogues.speaker: Yongzan
dialogues.text: If you're here for business, you can go talk to Han at the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency.

dialogues.speaker: Yongzan
dialogues.text: It's almost time for tea. What should I eat?

dialogues.speaker: Yongzan
dialogues.text: What do you think? Wait, you don't seem to be from around here. Never mind...
